headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 11, 2026**
article:
The Toronto Blue Jays secured a thrilling 2-1 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Simeon Woods Richardson earning the win and Louis Varland notching the save. The New York Mets took down the Atlanta Braves 8-5, led by Brett Baty's impressive performance, which included a home run and 4 RBIs. The Minnesota Twins defeated the Baltimore Orioles 9-5, with Josh Bell leading the Orioles' offense.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries and availability. Kervin Castro has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the New York Yankees due to right elbow neuritis. Hunter Greene has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list by the Cincinnati Reds due to right elbow soreness. Jameson Taillon has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Toronto Blue Jays due to right forearm tendinits.

Notable trades and roster movements include Jacob Berry being traded to the Kansas City Royals from the Miami Marlins. The Philadelphia Phillies traded Seth Johnson to the Athletics for Colby Thomas. The Miami Marlins traded Lake Bachar to the Pittsburgh Pirates for Brandan Bidois, Brian Sanchez, and Hyun Seung Lee. The Colorado Rockies traded Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for Connor Norby and Aiden May.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Red Sox in Thrilling Match**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 2-1 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Simeon Woods Richardson earning the win and Louis Varland notching the save.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Braves in Thrilling 8-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured an 8-5 win over the Atlanta Braves, with Brett Baty leading the charge at the plate. Baty's impressive performance included a home run and 4 RBIs, while Brent Suter pitched 3 strong innings with 3 strikeouts and no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Orioles 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 9-5 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Josh Bell leading the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Dean Kremer pitched 7 strong innings for the Orioles, striking out 7 and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Phillies Edge Cardinals in Thrilling 6-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a hard-fought 6-5 win over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Andrew Painter earning the win.

top_news.title: **Yankees RHP Kervin Castro Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: New York Yankees right-hander Kervin Castro has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow neuritis, effective retroactive to August 10, 2026.

top_news.title: **Berry Joins Royals in Trade**
top_news.summary: Jacob Berry has been traded to the Kansas City Royals. The 1B was previously with the Miami Marlins.
